name: slate
description: Launch films, feature announcements, ads, teasers, loops, logo stings and UI walkthroughs from code, directed by Claude: ideas drawn from the product and a 273-technique library, the product live in the film, two engines (Slate's HTML/GSAP renderer, or cinetic's Remotion and HyperFrames), a composed score, 60 fps motion blur, and a critic, pixel forensics and originality check before delivery.
